scope: Selected table continuation repair and base-slide metadata preservation
review_method: Main-agent testing, adversarial, and agent-native perspectives; not an independent visual verdict
reproduced_before_fix: Requesting the second six-row table with a two-row page budget returned one page because the first two-row table was selected instead.
Expansion discarded authored eyebrow, headline, takeaway, composition, overlays and source hyperlink, plus internal column and section context.
implementation: Path-targeted repair delegates its resolved table index to the existing expansion implementation; the declarative envelope still selects the first table.
Expansion retains the entire base slide and replaces selected table rows and optional title suffix. Existing first-page-only source and speaker-note behavior includes the source hyperlink.
Selected table row slices are copied. Other metadata pointers remain shared; this is not a general deep-clone operation.

evidence: Typed and legacy second-table inputs retain exact row order, original content position and the untouched first table.
Actual repair_slide MCP response contains three correctly patched pages and retains authored context, conclusion and first-page source hyperlink.
Named-placeholder path and partial final page are covered; editing expanded row storage leaves source row storage unchanged.
Invalid paths, zero row budget and row-span boundary violations fail without changing source JSON.
Existing declarative expansion and first/default repair tests are included in the targeted race suite.
residual_risks: Whole-repository local race suite was not rerun for this patch; CI remains a required gate.
testing_gaps: Fresh rendered continuation decks still need independent visual review.

evidence: Resolved numeric and named targets survive the caller-to-expander boundary instead of silently falling back to the first table.
A cross-page merged cell is rejected before slide-array replacement.
A partial SlideInput literal no longer removes newly added authored or internal fields during pagination.
residual_risks: Splitting one table repeats non-target content. Multiple overflowing tables require coordinated authoring; independently splitting each table is not a proven visual solution.
Shared metadata pointers are retained, not deep-cloned. Later in-place mutation of that metadata is outside the row-storage guarantee.
Legacy title values and visual title-suffix fitting are not newly repaired by this change.
testing_gaps: No claim that the retained 47 native-corpus source-loss pages are visually repaired.

agent_native_review.verdict: PASS for changed target-selection and metadata-return behavior
agent_native_review.evidence: Actual agent-facing tool response is parsed back into PresentationInput and checked for exact selected rows and retained authored metadata.
